title: Tabular Q-Learning Updates
signature: def q_learning(Q: np.ndarray, transitions: list, alpha: float, gamma: float) -> np.ndarray
hints: Copy Q first so you don't modify the input.
For each transition, the TD target is r if done, otherwise r + gamma * max(Q[s_next]).
Apply the transitions one at a time, in order. A later transition must see the Q values written by earlier ones.
